features.name: normalized_credit_amount
features.description: Min-max normalized credit amount to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the large magnitude of credit_amount from dominating the Euclidean distance metric in KNN.

features.name: normalized_duration
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the temporal dimension of the loan for balanced distance computation.

features.name: normalized_age
features.expected_model_benefit: Puts age on the same scale as other normalized continuous features, improving neighborhood geometry.

features.name: log_credit_per_month
features.description: Log-transformed ratio of credit amount to duration, representing the monthly principal burden.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a smooth, scale-appropriate feature representing monthly financial commitment, useful for finding similar financial profiles.

features.name: normalized_installment_commitment
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales the ordinal installment commitment to a [0,1] range, making it directly comparable to other normalized features in distance metrics.

features.name: distance_to_typical_applicant
features.description: Euclidean distance to the unsupervised global mean of standardized numeric features (duration, credit_amount, age).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a radial basis feature that helps KNN identify outliers versus typical applicants based on overall numeric profile.

features.name: is_young_high_credit
features.description: Indicator for applicants under 30 requesting more than 5000 in credit.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a distinct spatial cluster for a specific demographic-financial intersection, allowing KNN to form tighter local neighborhoods.

features.name: age_to_credit_ratio
features.description: Ratio of log-transformed credit amount to age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relationship between life stage and requested credit magnitude, providing a normalized continuous coordinate for similarity search.

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of financial stability based on checking_status, savings_status, and employment duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects multiple categorical financial indicators into a single continuous dimension, reducing categorical sparsity for distance calculations.

features.name: asset_quality_index
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the applicant's assets based on property_magnitude, housing, and savings_status.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a unified numeric representation of wealth and collateral, improving the meaningfulness of Euclidean distances between applicants.

features.name: social_stability_indicator
features.description: Semantic score representing social rootedness based on residence_since, housing, personal_status, and num_dependents.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates demographic and living situation categories into a continuous metric, aiding KNN in finding socially similar peers.

features.name: credit_history_risk_proxy
features.description: Semantic evaluation of past credit behavior based on credit_history, existing_credits, and other_payment_plans.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates complex categorical credit histories into a linear scale, allowing KNN to group applicants with similar past financial behaviors.
